fix: auto-update overdue due payment every hour continuously

- Added centralized syncOverdueBookings() function
- Uses absolute formula: (planned + overtime hours) * rate - paidAmount
- Ensures due amount updates every hour, not just on first overdue
- Sync applied in userDashboard, receptionistDashboard, adminDashboard
- Also fixes return-key route to use same absolute formula
- Now shows live updated due payment across all panels
Optimize dashboard performance for mobile (INP fix) while preserving all logic and design
